advisories.claim: Assignment/exercise pairing takes the first unused same-day STK row for the underlying without checking quantity, so an unrelated same-day share trade earlier in file order receives the premium. Repro: option row code A qty 1, then STK buy 50, then STK buy 100 on the same day in the same account.

One share row pairs with one option row. If the broker posts a single aggregated share row for two same-day assigned contracts (qty 200), the second option falls through to an ordinary option close in its own pool. Repro: two option rows code A qty 1 each plus one STK row qty 200.

compute_gains mutates the caller's Transaction.raw (stamps _roll_cad on share rows and pops it), and _attach_premium adjusts an existing event's acb or outlays after _apply_superficial may already have run on it. Not reproduced here; check the combined superficial-loss plus exercise case.

All of other_income is treated as pensionable for the CPP credit, but the field's own comment says it includes pensions, which carry no CPP. A pension-plus-business income would wrongly reduce business CPP.
The comment says 'a salary below the basic exemption' but the input is 40000, which is above the 3500 exemption, so the below-exemption case is untested.
The end-to-end test checks the summary card against the ledger key other_income but not against the key the Settings page saves to. Confirm they match.
The smoke assertion depends on Qt (qapp). Confirm it actually runs rather than skipping, and check the summary card grid layout after adding a sixth card.
The Comm/Fee sign flip assumes every IBKR export carries fees as negative; the previous abs() may have been there for an export format that does not.
